origins.title: Systems Change Lab: indicators of progress on the shifts needed for 1.5 °C

processing.description: Read the 438 indicator metadata files in the Systems Change Lab export (sha256 1c4ed351ea59…, retrieved 2026-10-05); 196 are outcome indicators with a progress status, the rest enablers and barriers, which have none.

Left out the 17 outcome indicators whose data sources name the International Energy Agency (BLDG-11, BLDG-15, BLDG-24, BLDG-25, BLDG-37, CTY-21, FIN-86, IN-2, PWR-41, PWR-42, PWR-50, PWR-58, TRNS-27, TRNS-28, TRNS-29, TRNS-31, X-FIN-85).
Counted the remaining 179 outcome indicators by Systems Change Lab's status and divided each count by their total, times 100.

scope.basis: Systems Change Lab's own progress status for each outcome indicator, as listed in its data export on the day it was downloaded; enabler and barrier indicators carry no status and are not counted.

title: Progress of the shifts needed for 1.5 °C (Systems Change Lab)

unit.label: percent of Systems Change Lab outcome indicators
